title: Where most absorption happens
hook: Locate one step on the digestive map.

knows: Digestion involves several organs and routes.
doesNotKnow: Most nutrient absorption occurs in the small intestine, whose folds and villi increase the surface available for absorption.

misconception: All digestive processes happen in a single organ.
objective: Locate the stated digestive process or absorption route.

claims.text: Question, diagram and explanation: In which part of the human digestive tract does most nutrient absorption take place? Most nutrient absorption occurs in the small intestine, whose folds and villi increase the surface available for absorption.
The map shows selected connections schematically; it is not an anatomical scale drawing or a complete account of digestion.
